text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The trickster has made a complete comeback, huh~
I got totally played too.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
No, describing it as a trick would be inaccurate.
That is merely one facet of who you are.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "Sei-chan was simply the strongest Umamusume here today. That is all there is to it."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Wah, that's quite a heavy burden to live up to.
Still... thanks.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It makes you excited, it keeps you on edge... and makes you want to work even harder!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
“—Heeey there~.
It's Sei-chan, the Grand Prix Umamusume☆”

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yes, exactly, this is it!
This is what I wanted to hear!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha, tricked 'em yet again♪
This is so fun—"

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"Seiun Sky, congratulations!!
I believed you'd win!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Congrats!!
That was so much fun~!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty sure these cheers are for when the favorite Umamusume
wins just as everyone expected, though.
choice_data_list: Then there's no doubt that's praise meant for you.
Then there's no doubt that's praise meant for you.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
choice_data_list: You reeled in a big one, huh!
You reeled in a big one, didn't you!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Besides... we're gonna be reeling in
even bigger 'trophy catches' together from now on, aren't we?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. Sure enough, if you reel in a big catch like this,
you're bound to become the huge favorite."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Something like this...
isn't half bad, I guess."
